verdict.rationale: Viam's docs say the fleet management API manages the fleet with code the same way as the web UI, and that the CLI can call any API method a machine serves. Separate APIs cover data querying and ML training, and the docs say an agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine the same way a person can. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of UI/API parity, evidence that UI-only flows (inline module browser editor, dataset annotation, test panels, setup wizard) have API equivalents, and a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The fleet management API allows you to manage your machine fleet with code the same way you can do in the web UI.
The CLI can call any API method a machine serves, with JSON in and JSON out. That makes it a complete way to operate a machine from a shell
An AI agent with a shell or an SDK can operate a Viam machine the same way a person or a program can.
